Ravi (procure): KizunaTech just called — shipment AWB 882-661-900 has been flagged at customs (export quarantine). Need routing + RMA decision.
Nina (infra): how many units and model? which depot?
Ravi (procure): 4x A800s, origin JP, currently at SIN transload hub. Vendor suggests cross-ship 2x air to SIN local depot, 2x sea to EU pool. Regional export control prevents direct ap-southeast delivery unless we sign end-user cert.
KizunaTech: correct, export compliance requires end-user declaration for shipping to APAC. We can do air to SIN if Redwood signs EUD form. Air expedite cost = $3.5k/unit + broker. Sea route covered under warranty, ETA 18-28 days.
Jordan (sre): ap-southeast1 capacity is booked next week for eval runs — losing 4 A800s will throttle batch jobs. Shortfall impact: longer queue times and potential missed eval window.
Priya (eng): can we reassign jobs to us-east? network egress + latency will affect model quality checks. Not ideal but possible. Any way to hotpool from EU?
Nina (infra): we have 2 warm pool slots in sin-depot but require a VLAN ACL and image bake. Bake + ACL = ~30h. If air arrives in 48h, tight. If we choose sea, we have 2 spare in eu-dedicated that can be prepped in 24h.
Ravi (procure): vendor sent invoice line: "882-661-900 | 2x A800 air-expedite | expedite fee $7000 | customs broker $600". They also attached EUD form.
FinanceBot: Flagged for EmergencyApprove; estimated OOP if air: $8.2k total. Sea = $0 unit cost but 18-28 day delay.
KizunaTech: we can also consolidate with another outbound AWB (same day) and reduce broker fee by 30% if Redwood agrees to consolidated paperwork.
Ravi (procure): tradeoffs: pay ~$8k to recover 2 units in 48-72h vs wait 3+ weeks and potentially miss eval run. Ops impact estimate: ~ $10k/day in delayed runs and SLO risk for scheduled tests.
Jordan (sre): if we get 2 early A800s in SIN, we can surface them to the canary pool and split traffic 15% to validate. Need infra prep for ACL window at 01:00 UTC tomorrow.
Priya (eng): can implement canary plan, will prepare migration playbook and metrics to monitor.
Nina (infra): I can do bake + ACL if vendor confirms ETA and we sign EUD. Will need network window approval.
Ravi (procure): action list: 1) Legal to review EUD 2) Finance emergency approval for broker+expedite 3) Vendor confirm consolidated AWB to get discount 4) DepotBot create RMA ticket and attach photos.
FinanceBot: EmergencyApprove routed to BillingOps, ETA 3h. Please attach cost center.
DepotBot: RMA created RMA-7925 | AWB 882-661-900 | status: export_quarantine | photos + COA attached.
KizunaTech: note — if EUD not signed within 6h we will default to sea split and consolidate at EU pool.
Ravi (procure): @Legal please advise on EUD; @BillingOps please prioritize. If we greenlight, Nina please start bake prep.
Nina (infra): will stage images and schedule ACL window for 01:00 UTC. Posting checklist after prep.
Jordan (sre): adding a quick grep of current queue to estimate impact: `kubectl get pods -n eval | grep a800 | wc -l` — we should quantify before final call.
Priya (eng): will run that and post numbers.
Ravi (procure): noted. Keeping thread open until BillingOps responds. :hourglass:
